summary.headline: Saturn Rising and Setting in the Signs
summary.text: Astrological predictions for the rising and setting of Saturn in Gemini, Cancer, Leo, Virgo, and Libra, including effects on rain, weather, rulers, agriculture, disease, war, and commerce. Hermes assigns additional outcomes to the first, second, and third thirds of each sign.
